title: slackRequest
responsibility: Calls the Slack Web API without redirects and maps provider failures to bounded transport errors.

inputs.name: slackRequest.fetchImpl
inputs.description: HTTP fetch implementation used to send the request.

inputs.name: slackRequest.method
inputs.description: Slack Web API operation, used to select the request method and classify delivery failures.

inputs.name: slackRequest.token
inputs.description: Bearer token from the calling adapter's scoped binding.

inputs.name: slackRequest.options
inputs.description: Provider parameters and whether the calling adapter is using a workspace member grant.

outputs.name: slackRequest
outputs.description: Decoded provider payload for the caller to validate, or null if JSON decoding fails.

errors.name: SlackRequestError
errors.description: Reports rate limits, provider refusal or unavailability, expired user grants, and ambiguous post delivery.
